name: Aldor Acres Christmas Trees
description:
Al-Dor Farms is a family-run farm in Glen Valley, just 5 km east of historic Fort Langley. Albert and Dorothy Anderson bought the land in 1971, and by 1988, they had placed a small sign and an honour-system jar at the end of the road to sell pumpkins. What began as a simple roadside idea quickly grew into a beloved local tradition, complete with tractor-drawn hayrides and hands-on farm experiences.

Today, the Anderson family continues that legacy, welcoming visitors year-round with a focus on family-friendly fun, hands-on education, and friendly farm animals. The farm hosts a variety of seasonal events:

- Spring & Summer – school tours, birthday parties, private and corporate events
- Easter, Mother’s Day & Father’s Day – public openings with festive farm activities
- Fall – the Pumpkin Patch & Seasonal Market, offering fresh corn, U-pick sunflowers, pumpkins, sausages, artisan products, and farm animals
- December – a Christmas market and Christmas trees, complete with farm animals, hot chocolate, marshmallows by the campfire, and festive cheer.

From pumpkins to Christmas trees, from hayrides to holiday markets, Al-Dor Farms is dedicated to creating experiences where families can connect with nature, celebrate traditions, and make lasting memories.
categories: Christmas Tree Farms, Pumpkin Patches, Petting Zoo, Corn Farms
amenities: Wreaths For Sale, Garlands For Sale, Tree Stands, Gift Shop, Photography Allowed, Restrooms
varieties: Douglas Fir, Fraser Fir, Noble Fir, Nordmann Fir, Live Spruce Fir

name: Bachner Family Christmas Tree Farm
description:
Bachner Family Christmas Tree Farm is rooted in a proud family tradition that began over 40 years ago, when Michael Bachner Sr. planted the farm’s very first Christmas trees. Today, four generations later, the Bachner family continues to carry on that legacy, nurturing trees with the same dedication and care that started it all.

The farm is committed to sustainable growth and hands-on care. Each tree is hand-trimmed in early summer, and with the help of irrigation, fertilization, and careful maintenance, the Bachners ensure that every tree grows healthy, full, and ready for families to enjoy. In April 2025, the farm introduced a new planting of Balsam–Fraser Fir cross trees, which will take several years to mature and offer even more variety for future generations.

For more than 35 years, Bachner Family Christmas Tree Farm has been providing the community with White Spruce, Fraser Fir, and other high-quality trees, grown with pride and care. With each new season, the family continues to strengthen its roots—both in the soil and in the community—ensuring that the tradition of bringing home a beautiful, fresh Christmas tree lives on for generations to come.
varieties: White Spruce, Balsam Fir, Fraser Fir

name: Boisé Brabant
description:
To enjoy the experience of cutting your own Christmas tree at Boisé Brabant, visitors are asked to book a date in advance at 721 Martel Rd. This system helps manage demand, reduce crowding, and ensure a safe, enjoyable visit for everyone, while also protecting the long-term sustainability of the tree plantation. Please note that the season is shorter this year, and trees will only be available while supplies last.

Boisé Brabant was founded in 2002 when Sylvie and Yvon embraced the chance to build something new as retirement approached. What began as a small Christmas tree venture has blossomed into both a family tradition and a local destination, where three generations now work together to welcome visitors each holiday season.

The farm offers an extensive selection of trees, from classics like Balsam Fir, Fraser Fir, White Spruce, and Blue Spruce to newly planted varieties including White Pine, Jack Pine, and Hemlock. For those seeking a more natural option, uncultivated spruce “wildlings” are also available at a reduced price. Sustainability is central to operations: no pesticides are used, and every tree harvested is replaced with new plantings by hand in the spring or fall.

In 2020, a sugar shack was added to the property, giving the family the ability to tap 325 red maples for small-batch maple syrup. This syrup is available throughout the year and during the Christmas tree season, adding a sweet tradition to the farm’s offerings.

At Boisé Brabant, guests will find more than just Christmas trees—they’ll discover a place where family values, nature, and holiday traditions come together to create lasting memories.
categories: Christmas Tree Farms, Maple Syrup Farms
amenities: Free Parking, Photography Allowed, Saw Included
varieties: Fraser Fir, Balsam Fir, White Spruce, Blue Spruce, White Pine, Jack Pine, Hemlock

name: Briggs Trees
description:
Briggs Tree Farm is a family-owned and operated farm that has been growing and selling Christmas trees to the Ottawa community for over 40 years. Nestled within a beautiful 100-acre woodland, the farm offers a traditional and memorable holiday experience where visitors can stroll through the forest to find their perfect tree.
The farm features a variety of trees ideal for Christmas, including Scotch Pine, Balsam Fir, White Spruce, and Norway Spruce. Each tree is carefully trimmed to maintain a natural shape, with a range of sizes and fullness to suit every home and holiday style.
Visitors are invited to enjoy a walk through the scenic woods, cut their own spruce, balsam, or scotch pine tree, and select a handcrafted natural Christmas wreath—making Briggs Tree Farm a festive destination for families year after year.
amenities: Wreath For Sale, Brush & Greenery, Gift Shop
varieties: Balsam Fir, Scotch Pine, White Spruce, Norway Spruce

name: Dawson Christmas Tree Farm
description:
Crone’s Christmas Tree Farm is a family-owned and operated farm dedicated to making holiday traditions memorable. Located in Millbrook, ON, the farm offers a beautiful selection of Balsam, Fraser, and Douglas Fir trees, all professionally groomed and chemical-free, ensuring that every tree brought home is healthy, fresh, and ready to brighten the season.

Known for its friendly atmosphere and exceptional customer service, Crone’s has become a favorite for families looking to cut their own tree and enjoy a festive outing. Visitors can warm up by the fire, sip on hot chocolate, enjoy food and beverages from Muster Point, and take holiday photos to capture the day. The staff goes above and beyond to make every visit welcoming and memorable, creating a tradition families return to year after year.

With limited selection as the season progresses, guests are encouraged to come early for the best trees. At Crone’s Christmas Tree Farm, you’ll not only find the perfect tree—you’ll also find a place where community, holiday spirit, and family traditions flourish.

name: Drysdale's
description:
Drysdale’s is a 4th-generation tree farm located in Egbert, Ontario, just an hour north of Toronto. Established in 1945 by Reginald Drysdale, the farm has grown into a well-known destination for Christmas trees, landscape trees, and memorable seasonal events.

Specializing in award-winning Christmas trees cultivated on its plantations since its founding, Drysdale’s offers a wide variety of mature trees direct from the grower, with optional delivery and installation services. For property owners, professional consultations are available to help select the ideal trees for beauty, privacy, and long-term growth.

Beyond its tree-growing legacy, Drysdale’s is also a venue for rustic weddings and other special events, providing a charming countryside setting for celebrations. While the farm no longer sells potted perennials and shrubs to the public, it remains committed to its core tradition—growing exceptional trees and helping families and communities create lasting memories.

name: Alouette Tree Farm Ltd
description:
Alouette Christmas Tree Farm is a family-owned and operated farm located in the beautiful community of Maple Ridge, BC. With a strong commitment to tradition and quality, the farm provides families with fresh Christmas trees and handcrafted wreaths, bringing the warmth and magic of the season from their farm to your home.

Known for their Grand Firs, Noble Firs, and Fraser Firs, the team at Alouette takes great pride in ensuring that each tree is healthy, full, and ready to be decorated. Customers appreciate the farm’s welcoming atmosphere, knowledgeable staff, and the care they put into helping families select the perfect holiday centerpiece.

To make the season last, Alouette Christmas Tree Farm also provides expert guidance on keeping your tree fresh, green, and vibrant throughout the holidays. From trimming the stump to proper watering and placement, their helpful tips ensure every family enjoys a safe and beautiful tree for weeks to come.

Whether you’re choosing a tree, picking up a handmade wreath, or just stopping by for friendly advice, Alouette Christmas Tree Farm makes every visit a joyful holiday tradition.

name: Balsam Ridge Christmas Tree Farm
description:
Balsam Ridge Christmas Tree Farm in Burtts Corner, New Brunswick, is a welcoming family-run destination for fresh, beautifully shaped Christmas trees. Known for their friendly service and family-friendly atmosphere, the owners go out of their way to make the experience enjoyable—especially for kids.

The farm offers a choose-and-cut experience, where visitors can walk the grounds and tag their perfect tree for the season. Customers praise the trees for being full, healthy, and well-shaped, ensuring every family can bring home a tree that’s just right for their holiday celebrations.

Whether it’s your first visit or a returning tradition, Balsam Ridge Christmas Tree Farm is a place where great trees, warm hospitality, and festive spirit come together to make the season special.
amenities: Wreaths For Sale, Saw Included
varieties: Balsam Fir

name: Barrett's Christmas Tree Farm
description:
Barrett’s Christmas Tree Farm opens for the season on November 29, 2025, welcoming families daily from 9am to 5pm through Christmas Eve. A family-owned farm rooted in tradition, Barrett’s offers both U-Cut and Pre-Cut Christmas trees, including premium Blue Spruce, with trees available in a variety of sizes. U-Cut trees up to 8ft are $62, with limited options above 8ft, while Pre-Cut trees range from $60–$110.

The farm is more than a place to find your perfect tree—it’s a holiday destination. Guests can enjoy the Family Fun Farm area (booking recommended), cozy up with hot chocolate or hot apple cider at the new Snack Shack, and indulge in treats like Grandma’s shortbread cookies, butter crunch chocolate, popcorn, and s’mores kits. On weekends, wagon rides run throughout the day, while horse-drawn wagon and sleigh rides add a magical touch for just $5 (weather permitting).

Families will also find plenty of festive activities: a play structure built by Bob for his kids in 1999, a bean bag toss game, and even a piece of aviation history—an authentic airplane displayed on the farm’s runway, restored to resemble a WWII Spitfire. Around the property, four campfire pits provide the perfect spot to warm up and roast marshmallows.

At Barrett’s Christmas Tree Farm, every detail—from hand-built benches to friendly staff—makes the experience more than just choosing a tree. It’s about creating family memories, celebrating the season, and enjoying a tradition that blends nature, history, and holiday fun.

name: Bastien Christmas Tree Farm
description:
Bastien Christmas Tree Farm has been family-owned and operated since 1995, proudly helping families create lasting holiday traditions. With approximately 15,000 trees at various stages of growth, including firs, spruces, and pines, the farm offers a wide selection of fresh Christmas trees for every home.

More than just a tree farm, Bastien Christmas Tree Farm is a destination for festive family outings. Guests can enjoy the nature trail, cozy campfire, photo centre, concession stand, and more, making each visit a memorable holiday experience.

Dedicated to keeping the spirit of Christmas alive, the Bastien family invites you to share in the joy of choosing a real tree and celebrating Christmas together.

name: BellyAcres Tree Farm
description:
BellyAcres Tree Farm is a family-friendly destination where holiday traditions come alive. Conveniently located just off the main road, the farm makes it easy for families to choose and cut their own Christmas tree. Visitors often remark on the welcoming atmosphere, friendly staff, and the care Andrew and Louise take to ensure everyone has a memorable experience.

The farm offers a wide selection of well-trimmed pines and firs at reasonable prices, along with thoughtful touches such as saws, tree wrapping, and even candy-cane painted tools. Guests can enjoy the festive outdoor setting, warm up by the fire, and take home a beautiful fresh-cut tree to make their holiday season complete.

In addition to Christmas trees, BellyAcres Tree Farm is also home to pussy willows, available for seasonal decorating and traditions. With a commitment to environmentally friendly practices, the farm avoids chemicals and focuses on supporting the local community.

Whether it’s your first visit or part of a long-standing family tradition, BellyAcres Tree Farm is a place where memories are made, trees are fresh, and the holiday spirit thrives.

name: Blitzen Estate
description:
Blitzen Estate is a Christmas tree, maple syrup, and horse farm located in Jasper, Ontario, created by Caylyn and Kevin after leaving behind their fast-paced corporate careers. With backgrounds in health and safety management and corporate sales, the couple traded in global travel and high-stakes deals for small-town living and a farm that celebrates nature, tradition, and seasonal joy.

At Blitzen Estate, visitors will find more than just Christmas trees and maple syrup. Caylyn’s passion for horses brings unique experiences to the farm, with plans for sleigh rides, haunted hay rides, and other seasonal events that capture the festive spirit. Meanwhile, Kevin’s love for country living, combined with his people skills and storytelling, creates a warm and welcoming atmosphere for guests year-round.

With a focus on community, tradition, and creativity, Blitzen Estate is quickly becoming a local destination where families can gather, celebrate, and make memories in every season.

name: Blue Harvest Farm
description:
Blue Harvest Farm is more than a Christmas tree farm—it’s a place built to feel like home. Originally the family homestead, it is now run by the owner, her husband David, their children Blake and Samira, and their red retriever Elaina. Surrounded by beautiful views and breathtaking sunsets, the farm invites guests to experience the joy of choosing the perfect Christmas tree while creating lasting family memories.

Giving back has always been at the heart of Blue Harvest Farm. For many years, the family hosted an annual sale of one-of-a-kind garden trial plants to support local charities and their hospital. Today, that tradition of generosity continues with the Giving Tree Ornaments, where 100% of sales go directly toward helping local families enjoy a memorable Christmas.

During the holiday season, visitors can enjoy festive experiences including Santa’s visit, holiday crafts, gifts, seasonal décor, and Christmas photo opportunities—all designed to bring warmth, joy, and community spirit to every guest.

name: Boat Harbour Farm
description: Boat Harbour Farm is a 5-acre Christmas tree farm located in Cedar, BC, just south of Nanaimo. It offers a 'you pick, we cut, we shake, you load' experience, allowing customers to choose their tree while it's still standing in the field. The farm grows a variety of tree types including Douglas Fir, Grand Fir, Noble Fir, Nordmann Fir, Concolor Fir, Colorado Spruce, and Canaan Fir. Customers can park in the lower field and take their time selecting the perfect tree. After the tree is cut, it is shaken to remove loose needles, bird nests, and other debris. Pets are welcome but must be kept on a leash. The farm accepts cash, credit, and debit payments. It will be closed until the 2025 Christmas season.
amenities: Free Parking

name: CD Trees
description:
CD Trees offers a full Christmas experience that goes far beyond selecting a tree. Families can choose and cut their own balsam fir, white spruce, or Scots pine, or select from a wide range of pre-cut premium trees. In addition, the farm provides handcrafted wreaths and operates a holiday gift shop featuring locally made decorations, beauty products, stained glass, and Redpoll Farms preserves.

Visitors are invited to stay for the day and enjoy a range of seasonal activities. Horse-drawn sleigh rides provide a classic winter experience, while walking trails, fire pits, and a gentle toboggan run make the farm a festive destination for all ages. Hot drinks, homemade soups, baked goods, and light meals are available on-site, adding to the welcoming atmosphere.

Customers consistently praise CD Trees for its friendly service, well-staffed operation, and the ability to create lasting family traditions. From cutting the perfect tree to warming up with hot chocolate after a sleigh ride, CD Trees offers an authentic, memorable way to celebrate the season.

name: Carole's Christmas Tree Farm
description:
Carole’s Christmas Tree Farm has been family-owned and operated for more than 25 years, continuing a cherished tradition of offering a natural and memorable Christmas tree experience. Now in its ninth season under the current generation, the farm was built on the idea of recreating the timeless tradition of families strolling through forests in search of the perfect Christmas tree.

In 2023, Carole’s Christmas Tree Farm made the difficult decision to suspend its cut-your-own service. This change allows the farm to rehabilitate, while also addressing liability concerns and the increase in vandalism experienced during the 2022 season.

Dedicated to sustainability, Carole’s Christmas Tree Farm emphasizes the many benefits of real Christmas trees. Unlike artificial options, natural trees are renewable, biodegradable, and environmentally friendly—providing oxygen, shelter for wildlife, and the unmistakable fragrance of a true holiday tree.

Visitors are also invited to explore the Gift Shop, which offers an excellent selection of locally made, high-quality crafts perfect for gifting or decorating during the season.

Carole’s Christmas Tree Farm extends warm holiday wishes and looks forward to remaining a beloved part of local Christmas traditions for years to come.
amenities: Gift Shop, Hot Cider, Sugar Cookies, Free Parking, Picnic Tables
varieties: Balsam Fir, Fraser Fir, Scotch Pine

name: Catfish Creek Christmas Tree Farm
description:
Catfish Creek Christmas Tree Farm has a rich history rooted in family tradition. The land was first purchased in 1974 by Gordon’s parents, where Gordon spent his childhood helping with farm life—selling eggs, raising chickens, and caring for horses.

In 2002, Gordon purchased the farm from his parents and began shaping it with his own vision. By 2009, alongside his wife Corinne, the couple planted and began maintaining 500 Christmas tree seedlings, laying the foundation for what would become a cherished holiday destination.

Today, Catfish Creek Christmas Tree Farm is proudly operated by Gordon, Corinne, and their son, combining the legacy of a traditional family farm with the magic of a Christmas tree farm. Each season, they provide their community with festive experiences, lasting memories, and the joy of finding the perfect Christmas tree.

name: Cedar Hill Christmas Tree Farm
description:
Cedar Hill Christmas Tree Farm is a family-run operation rooted in the agricultural traditions of Cedar Hill since the 1820s. Originally established as a lumbering and sawmill property, the farm has served over the years as a dairy, beef, and sheep operation before expanding into fruit crops in 1978 and Christmas trees in 1988.

The farm is now owned and operated by the Martin family—Grant, Pam, Todd, Neil, Adam, and Graham—who bring with them a strong agricultural background, having previously managed an organic dairy farm before purchasing Cedar Hill in 2016. With decades of experience behind them and a commitment to quality, the Martins continue the legacy of producing beautiful Christmas trees for families across the region.

With deep local roots, multi-generational stewardship, and a focus on maintaining the land’s heritage, Cedar Hill Christmas Tree Farm offers both tradition and quality for those seeking the perfect tree during the holiday season.

name: Chickadee Christmas Trees
description:
Chickadee Christmas Trees offers families an authentic, traditional Christmas tree experience in a scenic country setting. Established in 2002, the farm has grown from its first plantings in the late 1990s into a welcoming, family-run operation. Visitors can choose from quality pre-cut or cut-your-own trees and enjoy the festive atmosphere supported by family members, friends, and staff who help create a cheerful holiday tradition.

The farm is committed to environmental stewardship, dedicating land to reforestation, naturalized habitats, and pollinator-friendly practices. Chickadee also uses plastic-free, biodegradable netting for baling trees, ensuring an eco-friendly approach to Christmas traditions. With a focus on trees and greens such as wreaths and boughs, Chickadee Christmas Trees invites families to find their perfect tree while making lasting memories surrounded by the natural beauty of the farm.

name: Copeman Tree Farms
description:
Copeman Tree Farms is a family-run Christmas tree farm dedicated to growing premium-quality trees that are always fresh, beautifully fragrant, and carefully cultivated to last through the holiday season with proper care. Each tree is the result of more than a decade of attention and craftsmanship—taking approximately 12 years to mature, with the largest trees requiring up to 20 years of growth before reaching their full cathedral height.

Throughout the summer months, the family invests countless hours in shearing and pruning the trees into their iconic bushy, A-shaped form, ensuring a traditional and picturesque Christmas tree. In addition to offering trees, the farm welcomes visitors after the holidays to enjoy cross-country skiing, snowshoeing, sledding, and scenic walks among the snow-covered evergreens. With its blend of premium trees, careful cultivation, and year-round hospitality, Copeman Tree Farms provides families with both a festive holiday tradition and memorable outdoor experiences.

name: Country Christmas Trees
description: Country Christmas Trees is a women-owned, family-run tree farm known for its welcoming atmosphere, knowledgeable service, and high-quality selection of Christmas trees. The farm offers a diverse range of tree varieties, including some that are harder to find, along with handcrafted decorations such as wreaths and gnomes that are refreshed each year. Visitors consistently highlight the friendly and professional service, fair pricing, and the multi-generational family involvement in running the farm, from wreath-making to customer care. With beautiful trees, seasonal craftsmanship, and a tradition of hospitality, Country Christmas Trees has become a beloved destination for families looking to create lasting holiday memories.

name: Coupez Votre Sapin S.E.N.C
description:
Coupez Votre Sapin S.E.N.C is a family-run Christmas tree farm where holiday traditions come to life. Visitors are invited to stroll through the fields, enjoy the countryside, and choose the perfect fresh-cut tree that will stay fragrant and vibrant throughout the festive season. Children will love spotting the miniature horses and small animals around the farm, while families are welcome to bring a packed lunch and even their pets (on leash) for a full day of holiday fun.

The farm provides hand saws for cutting your tree, and staff are always available to assist if needed. Trees can be wrapped for easy transport (fees apply), and customers are reminded to bring rope or straps to secure their tree. For safety reasons, chainsaws are not permitted. Payment is cash only at the farm.

With its warm and welcoming atmosphere, wheelchair-accessible parking, and family-friendly setting, Coupez Votre Sapin S.E.N.C offers more than just Christmas trees—it’s a tradition that keeps visitors coming back year after year. Guests praise the farm for its beautiful, well-stocked trees, affordable prices, and friendly service, making it a must-visit destination for the holiday season.

name: Crawford Family Christmas Tree Farms
description:
Crawford Trees has been family owned and operated since 1988, growing premium-grade Christmas trees with care and dedication. Located at 300 Royalton Road, the Crawford family—Andrew, Colleen, and Jordan—have been replanting and cultivating trees from their very own seed orchard for more than three decades.

The farm specializes in Balsam Fir, Fraser Fir, and Cook Blue Fir, along with other carefully selected varieties. Each tree is nurtured to meet the highest standards, ensuring families can bring home a tree that is fresh, full, and beautifully shaped for the holiday season.

In addition to trees, Crawford Trees also handcrafts wreaths, offering a festive touch to complement your holiday décor. Open daily during daylight hours throughout the Christmas season, the farm provides a welcoming atmosphere where tradition and quality come together year after year.

name: Crone's Tree Farm
description:
Crone’s Christmas Tree Farm is a family-run, chemical-free farm that has become a beloved holiday tradition for many. Visitors rave about the warm welcome they receive, the friendly atmosphere, and the simple joy of choosing and cutting their own Christmas tree.

The farm offers a wide variety of fir trees, from smaller family-sized options to towering 12-foot beauties—all priced affordably, with past seasons featuring deals like $50 for any size. Guests are provided with saws and bailing, and a tractor ride back to the parking area adds a fun, convenient touch to the outing.

Customers consistently highlight the farm’s professionally groomed, fresh trees and the wonderful family that runs it, making every visit feel personal and festive. Whether it’s your first time cutting your own tree or a tradition you look forward to each year, Crone’s Christmas Tree Farm offers the perfect mix of beautiful trees, fair prices, and heartfelt hospitality.
amenities: Saw Included
varieties: Balsam Fir

name: Domaine Clovis
description:
Domaine Clovis is a family farm in Sainte-Anne-de-Sorel that celebrates the gifts of nature through both Christmas trees and maple syrup production. For more than a generation, the farm has combined eco-responsible agriculture with time-honored traditions to offer products that are authentic, sustainable, and crafted with care.

In the spring, the farm’s sugarbush of majestic red maples yields a rich, flavorful maple syrup. This pure syrup, produced to federation standards, is transformed into a variety of maple products—all available at the on-site boutique. Each item reflects the farm’s commitment to quality and the unmistakable taste of traditional Quebec maple.

During the holiday season, visitors are invited to wander through the Christmas tree fields, choose and cut their own tree, or select from a range of pre-cut options. Tree stands and festive decorations are also available, making it easy to bring the spirit of the season home. With environmentally conscious practices like natural ground covers, organic fertilizers, and a thriving ecosystem of birds and wildlife, Domaine Clovis ensures that every product and experience is rooted in respect for the land.

Whether you come for the maple syrup or the Christmas trees, Domaine Clovis offers a warm welcome, a taste of tradition, and memories to share with family year after year.
amenities: Maple Products, Tree Stands, Free Parking, Handicap Accessible, Gift Shop
varieties: Balsam Fir, Fraser Fir, Maple

name: Downey Trees
description:
Downey Trees & Nursery is a family-owned and operated farm with deep roots in Canada’s Christmas tree industry. Founded by Patrick F. Downey, a second-generation nurseryman, and his wife Linda, the farm has grown into one of the country’s most successful and respected tree farms, specializing in premium Balsam Firs and their exclusive TrueBlue Fraser®.

Visitors are invited to rediscover the magic of Christmas with a cut-your-own tree experience. Families can stroll through the plantation, select the perfect Fraser Fir, and then warm up by the fire with hot chocolate and sweet treats while their tree is wrapped—a tradition that turns tree shopping into a memorable outing.

As pioneers in Christmas tree research and innovation, Downey Trees takes pride in growing healthy, full trees and providing planting stock of the highest quality. Every tree is backed by a written freshness guarantee, ensuring that customers receive only the finest and freshest trees for their holiday celebrations.

With a reputation built on quality, tradition, and service, Downey Trees & Nursery continues to thrive thanks to the support of loyal customers, friends, and dedicated staff. Whether you’re choosing a family tree or sourcing wholesale stock, Downey delivers reliability, care, and holiday spirit season after season.
amenities: Fire Pit/Bonfire, Sugar Cookies, Hot Chocolate
varieties: Balsam Fir, TrueBlue Fraser Fir

name: Fernridge Christmas Tree Forest
description:
Fernridge Christmas Tree Farm has been owned and operated by the Neufeld family since 1988, with roots in growing and selling Christmas trees in the Vancouver area dating back to 1972. Now celebrating over three decades of operation, the farm has become a cherished part of many families’ annual holiday traditions.

Visitors can choose and cut their own tree from a wide selection—including Douglas Fir, Grand Fir, Fraser Fir, Canaan Fir, and Nordman Fir—or pick from fresh-cut trees available on the yard, such as Noble Firs. To complete the experience, Fernridge offers seasonal items including tree stands, preservatives, greens, and baling services for smaller trees. Complimentary hot chocolate, apple cider, and candy canes are provided to guests, making each visit festive and welcoming.

The farm is also committed to creating a safe and enjoyable experience for all, with clear guidelines for families, children, and pets. Beyond tree sales, Fernridge accommodates professional photographers before the season opens, offering its scenic grounds as a backdrop for holiday portraits. With friendly staff, family tradition, and a wide range of premium trees, Fernridge Christmas Tree Farm continues to be a trusted destination for Christmas memories in the Vancouver region.

name: Fir Ever Green Tree Farm
description:
Fir Ever Green Tree Farm is a family-owned and operated tree farm run by Peter and Judy Kappeler along with their daughters Julia and Amanda. The farm is a year-round destination, offering u-cut Christmas trees in the winter and landscaping trees during the warmer months.

Visitors can select from a wide variety of trees and enjoy the classic tradition of cutting their own, with saws provided for convenience. Tree wrapping and preparation services are also available to make transport and setup easy. Fresh wreaths and seasonal arrangements are offered alongside the trees, adding to the holiday atmosphere. Guests can also warm up at the outdoor fire pit and enjoy treats like beef jerky, with occasional locally made products available.

Families consistently praise the friendly and helpful staff, the abundance of healthy, beautiful trees, and the welcoming, festive atmosphere. With kid- and dog-friendly grounds, Fir Ever Green Tree Farm has become a cherished spot for starting or continuing Christmas traditions in a picturesque countryside setting.

name: Forrest Traditions
description:
Forrest Traditions is a family-owned and operated Christmas tree farm that has quickly become a favorite destination since opening in 2021. You are invited to stroll the property, enjoy the festive atmosphere, and choose their own tree, with staff on hand to assist and hand saws provided for convenience. The farm offers beautiful balsam trees averaging 7 to 9 feet—perfect for creating a traditional holiday centerpiece at home.

Visitors consistently praise the welcoming environment, friendly service, and fair pricing. Warm apple cider, cookies, and candy canes add to the holiday spirit, while the picturesque setting makes for a memorable outing with family and friends. Known for its quality trees and genuine hospitality, Forrest Traditions has already become part of many families’ annual Christmas traditions.

name: Georgian Bay Tree Farms
description:
Georgian Bay Tree Farms is a family-friendly u-cut Christmas tree farm offering a wide selection of balsam fir, Fraser fir, and blue spruce trees at fair prices. Visitors are welcomed by friendly staff who provide guidance on parking, tree selection, and cutting, with wagon rides available to bring families and their trees back from the fields.

In addition to beautiful trees, the farm offers fresh wreaths for sale and a festive atmosphere that brings customers back year after year. Guests appreciate the reasonable pricing—such as $60 for a six-foot tree—the accommodating service, and the tradition of finding the “perfect tree” with loved ones. The farm is also pet-friendly, making it easy for the whole family, including dogs, to join the holiday outing.

With its welcoming staff, scenic property, and well-maintained trees, Georgian Bay Tree Farms has become a trusted local destination for creating lasting Christmas traditions. Visitors are encouraged to check the farm’s social media for up-to-date information, as it operates on select weekends leading up to Christmas.

name: Gogo's Christmas Tree Farm
description:
Gogo’s Christmas Tree Farm has been family-owned since 1897 and is now operated by the fifth generation. Located in a scenic countryside setting, the farm has been offering Christmas trees since 1929, becoming a trusted source of high-quality, affordable trees for families across the region.

With more than 25,000 trees to choose from, visitors can enjoy a classic u-cut experience, with saws provided at the entrance. The farm also partners with schools and charitable organizations to support fundraising efforts, furthering its long-standing ties to the community. Guests are advised to take care when walking, as portions of the farm remain in their natural state.

In addition to providing trees at fair prices, Gogo’s Christmas Tree Farm extends goodwill each year by offering a free tree to single mothers facing financial hardship. This gesture reflects the farm’s commitment not only to tradition but also to community support and generosity.
amenities: Saw Included, Wreath For Sale
varieties: Balsam Fir, Noble Fir, Douglas Fir, Norway Spruce

name: Green HIlls Farm
description:
Green Hills Farm, located on over 10 acres of beautiful countryside, is proudly owned and operated by David and Jenna Lee Mombourquette. The couple purchased the farm in 2016, renaming the former Travis’ Tree Farm, where David had first started working at the age of 18. In 2020, they expanded further by acquiring the former Aucoin’s Family Tree Farm property, creating an even larger U-Cut destination for families.

The farm is more than just a business—it is also home to David, Jenna Lee, their children Rosa and Wyatt, and their two Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retrievers, Frankie and Holly. Their dedication to superior service, personalized attention, and welcoming atmosphere ensures that every visit to Green Hills Farm becomes a memorable holiday tradition.

name: Hadley Christmas Trees / Arbres de Noël
description:
? English
Located in the foothills of the Laurentians, just one hour north of Montreal, Hadley Christmas Trees offers the classic holiday tradition of choosing and cutting your own tree—or selecting from fresh precut Balsam and Fraser Firs at the barn. With thousands of well-cultivated, bushy trees to choose from, families are sure to find their perfect match.

Every tree purchase includes sales tax, round-trip transportation to and from the fields, baling, and hot chocolate for the whole family. Guests can also warm up in the festive Christmas shop, where local foods, crafts, tree stands, and tree-care products are available.

Whether you prefer the fragrant softness of a traditional Quebec Balsam Fir or the silvery sheen and strong branches of a Fraser Fir, Hadley provides an authentic countryside Christmas experience. Photographers are also welcome to use the farm as a backdrop for seasonal family photos.

? Open weekends in December.

? Français
Située dans les contreforts des Laurentides, à seulement une heure au nord de Montréal, la Sapinière Hadley vous invite à vivre la tradition de Noël en choisissant et coupant votre propre arbre, ou en sélectionnant un sapin Baumier ou Fraser fraîchement coupé à la grange. Avec des milliers de sapins bien cultivés et touffus, chaque famille trouvera l’arbre parfait.

Chaque achat inclut la taxe de vente, le transport aller-retour du champ, l’emballage de l’arbre et un chocolat chaud pour toute la famille. Réchauffez-vous ensuite dans la boutique de Noël où vous trouverez des produits locaux, de l’artisanat, des supports à sapin et des produits d’entretien.

Que vous choisissiez le parfum enivrant du sapin baumier du Québec ou l’élégance argentée et les branches solides du Fraser, Hadley vous offre une expérience authentique de Noël à la campagne. Les photographes sont également les bienvenus pour utiliser la sapinière comme décor pour leurs séances photos familiales.

? Ouvert les fins de semaine de décembre.

name: Harvey's Christmas Tree Farm

Harvey’s Christmas Tree Farm offers a cozy, family-run holiday experience filled with charm and tradition. With a wide variety of trees in all sizes—including smaller options, tall statement trees, and even potted varieties—there’s something for every home. For those wanting the full adventure, visitors can cut their own tree (6’–8’ sizes go quickly, so early season visits are best).

The farm also features a selection of festive holiday décor, from poinsettias and handmade wreaths to fresh greenery. Guests are welcomed with warmth and hospitality, often enjoying seasonal drinks and treats that make the outing even more memorable.

Rustic, inviting, and family-friendly, Harvey’s Christmas Tree Farm is the perfect place to find a fresh tree and create lasting holiday traditions.

For generations, Hendry’s Christmas Tree Farm has been the go-to destination for families seeking the perfect holiday tree near Smiths Falls. Known for its warm, welcoming atmosphere and beautifully cared-for trees, the farm makes the classic Christmas tradition easy and memorable. Guests can even drive right in to pick their tree, avoiding the long walks often required at larger farms.

Beyond trees, Hendry’s offers a charming country store filled with holiday delights, including homemade jams, honey, and unique gifts. Families return year after year, not only for the quality trees but also for the heartfelt hospitality that makes every visit special.

name: Hillcrest Tree Farm
description:
Situated on a historic 100-acre former dairy farm dating back to the 1800s, Hillcrest Tree Farm has been family-owned and operated since 1987. Dave and Bronwyn Harper transformed the once-abandoned property into a thriving Christmas tree farm, planting their first trees in 1993 and welcoming the public in 2000.

What began with a modest setup—using a section of the drive shed and a pickup truck—has grown into a well-established farm featuring an indoor tree lot housed in a 40 x 60-foot Coverall building. Visitors are welcomed each season to stroll the scenic property, choose their tree, and enjoy the warm, family-oriented atmosphere that Hillcrest is known for.

Blending history, hard work, and community spirit, Hillcrest Tree Farm remains a cherished destination for families creating Christmas traditions year after year.

name: Hockley Valley Farm
description:
Located in the scenic Hockley Valley, this family-owned farm blends a love of the land with a deep commitment to community and tradition. Owners Jason and Vikki realized their dream of leaving suburban life behind to embrace the serenity of country living. Jason, a lifelong draft horse enthusiast, can often be found driving his beloved Percherons, Ike and Duke, while Vikki brings her background in social services and customer care to create a welcoming environment for all visitors.

Their three children are also actively involved in caring for the animals and helping maintain the property, making it truly a family-run operation. With a foundation built on hard work, hospitality, and a love of the countryside, Hockley Valley Farm is a place where guests are welcomed to share in the peace and beauty of the valley while supporting a family passionate about farm life.

name: Hope’s Christmas Tree Farm

Nestled on the scenic Oak Ridges Moraine in Enniskillen, Ontario, Hope’s Christmas Tree Farm offers families a warm and festive holiday escape. Visitors can stroll the farm, choose a hand-picked Christmas tree, and enjoy a cozy seasonal atmosphere complete with fresh greenery, hot drinks, and the work of local artisans showcased in the farm’s historic 18th-century barn. Special touches like pre-booked visits with Santa and friendly farm animals make the experience even more memorable.

Founded by Dan and Rebecca Hope, university sweethearts with a background in environmental studies, the farm reflects their shared passion for the outdoors and dedication to sustainability. Since planting their first tree in 2010, the Hopes have worked tirelessly to grow their dream into a family-friendly destination that officially opened in 2020.

From the moment guests step onto the farm, they are invited to “watch us grow” and share in the timeless tradition of choosing a Christmas tree in a charming country setting.

name: Jingle Bills Christmas Tree Farm
description:
Welcome to Jingle Bills Christmas Tree Farm—Southern Ontario’s very own North Pole! Conveniently located just 15 minutes north of Burlington/Hamilton and 5 minutes south of Guelph in Puslinch County, Jingle Bills is your one-stop shop for fun, friends, and Christmas spirit.

The farm sits on 100 acres, including 30 acres of dense forest and a babbling brook, making the perfect backdrop for your holiday adventure. Families can search for their perfect tree, bring out the saw, and create memories that last a lifetime. Afterward, explore the Elves Marketplace, grab a treat from Jingle Deb’s Treat Tent, or let the kids enjoy the inflatable Farm Hopper Barnyard. Cozy fires and hot cocoa add to the festive atmosphere.

name: Karlson Evergreens Christmas Tree Farm
description:
Karlson Evergreens has been a cherished part of Ottawa’s holiday traditions for more than 30 years. Owner Karl began selling Christmas trees in 1983 at the age of 27, starting with pre-cut lots across the Ottawa area. In 1990, together with his wife Sonya, he opened Karlson Evergreens—offering just three species of trees that first season.

Today, the farm proudly provides six different species of Christmas trees from around the world, chosen for their breathtaking colour, fullness, fragrance, and excellent needle retention. Karl and Sonya’s mission has always been to make it possible for families to enjoy a tree that lasts beautifully throughout the holiday season, without the hassle of constant upkeep.

Each year, weeks of care and preparation go into hand-trimming every tree to ensure natural shape and fullness. To keep the farm thriving, seedlings are planted each spring to replace trees cut the previous year—safeguarding the tradition for generations to come.

At Karlson Evergreens, you’ll find not just a tree, but a lovingly cultivated part of your family’s Christmas celebration.

name: Laura's Christmas Trees

Laura’s Christmas Trees has been a family-operated tree farm since 1986, offering a welcoming, family-oriented atmosphere and a wide selection of quality Christmas trees. Operating as a cash-only farm, Laura’s also features handcrafted art and décor, landscaping trees, and additional services, making it more than just a place to find a tree.

Visitors can explore over two kilometers of walking trails, adding a peaceful outdoor experience to their holiday outing. On weekends in December, guests are treated to complimentary hot chocolate, candy canes, and dog treats (while supplies last). The farm is also dog-friendly, with leashes left to the discretion of owners, making it easy to bring the whole family along.

With its long history, friendly service, and thoughtful extras, Laura’s Christmas Trees provides both a festive outing and a touch of local artistry, continuing a tradition that has welcomed families for nearly four decades.

Leo’s Tree Farm has been growing memories since 1996, offering families a warm and festive Christmas tradition for over 20 years. Known for its passion for quality trees and welcoming atmosphere, the farm provides both pre-cut options and the classic cut-your-own experience in its scenic bush lots.

Visitors are invited to enjoy the full holiday experience, beginning with the rustic, wood-heated shack where complimentary hot chocolate is served. Guests can also stay a little longer to take part in chestnut roasting, a signature feature that has become a cherished highlight of the farm.

In addition to trees, Leo’s Tree Farm offers decorative swags for sale and even the materials for those who wish to create their own. Families are welcome to explore the property on nature walks, with leashed pets encouraged to join the outing.

description:
French:
Venez vivre une expérience d’autocueillette de sapins baumiers dans une ambiance festive et chaleureuse. Pour un prix minimum de 100 $, choisissez le sapin parfait pour votre foyer selon le forfait sélectionné lors de votre réservation. Chaque visite inclut l’emballage de votre arbre, l’accès à un espace de feu de camp pour vous réchauffer, et une boisson chaude au choix — un chocolat chaud réconfortant ou un bouillon de poulet revigorant. Vous êtes également invités à apporter vos propres collations et à immortaliser vos moments dans la zone photo prévue à cet effet.

Les réservations sont obligatoires, avec des plages horaires disponibles de 10h à 12h ou de 13h à 15h, les 23, 24, 30 novembre et le 1er décembre 2024. Une soirée VIP exclusive est aussi offerte le 30 novembre de 17h à 21h30, pour une expérience encore plus magique.

Come and enjoy a choose-and-cut balsam fir experience in a warm and festive atmosphere. For a minimum price of $100, you can select the perfect tree for your home, with packaging included. Each visit also comes with access to a cozy campfire area and your choice of a comforting hot chocolate or a revitalizing chicken broth. Guests are welcome to bring their own snacks and capture memories in the farm’s dedicated photo zone.

Reservations are required, with time slots available from 10 a.m. to 12 p.m. or 1 p.m. to 3 p.m. on November 23, 24, 30, and December 1, 2024. Don’t miss the exclusive VIP evening on November 30 from 5 p.m. to 9:30 p.m. for an even more memorable experience.

name: Little Creek Tree Farm
description:
Little Creek Tree Farm, owned and operated by Tom and Christin Ebert, is located just outside London, Ontario. With Tom’s diploma in Landscape Design from Fanshawe College and more than 30 years of experience in the tree industry, the farm has been providing high-quality trees and professional service since its founding in 2005. Over the years, the Eberts have planted more than 5,000 trees, serving both residential and commercial clients.

The farm specializes in Christmas trees, landscaping trees, and shrubs, offering services that range from schoolyard greening projects to large-scale planting in parks and private yards. Known for their careful attention to detail, timely work, and exceptional customer service, the team at Little Creek Tree Farm has earned praise from organizations like ReForest London as well as countless individual customers.

Families can also visit the farm during the holiday season to purchase Christmas trees, along with cedars and other evergreens, enjoying a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. With excellent selection, fair pricing, and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction, Little Creek Tree Farm has become a trusted name in both landscaping and seasonal traditions across the London area.

Little Lake Christmas Trees is a family-run farm operated by the Smyth family, dedicated to providing a warm and memorable Christmas experience. Guests consistently highlight the friendly service, beautiful setting, and Hallmark-movie atmosphere, with many families making Little Lake Christmas Trees an annual tradition for generations. Madeira Farms in Rockwood, Ontario, has been welcoming families to create Christmas traditions since 2004. What began with a roadside sign and hot cider served from a humble lean-to has grown into a cherished annual destination, now anchored by a beautiful timber-frame Shoppe. Many of the families who visited that first year still return, making the farm part of their holiday tradition.

The farm offers both cut-your-own trees—including pine, spruce, and fir—and Ontario-grown pre-cut Fraser and Balsam firs. To make the experience easy and enjoyable, saws and sleds are provided, and the Shoppe features handcrafted wreaths and sturdy tree stands for holiday decorating.

With its peaceful cedar bush and snow-covered fields, Madeira Farms remains a place of quiet seasonal beauty. Whether cutting your own tree or choosing a pre-cut option, families leave with more than just a Christmas tree—they leave with cherished memories.
